# S110 — Running: a live summary of every running project above Needs you in the sidebar

**Findings:**  · **Size:** M · **Tree:**

**Not in this slice:**

## Why

Owner 2026-10-25. Each project's own page shows what it runs at the top (status, stage bar, animation, sparkline), and a top-level entry above Needs you in the sidebar, Running, shows every project with a live run, always current: project, item, the pipeline with the running role, stage bar, round, last heard, sparkline and any question or stop that needs the owner. Enter drops into that run's pane (which follows the newest running run, see the run-pane-follow slice). 1 s refresh while visible. Builds on S97 (pipeline, last heard), S07 (stage bar, ticker, sparkline) and the run-pane-follow slice.
